name: dsh-pavement-structural-dynamics
description: An entire Chinese monograph on pavement structural dynamics (8 chapters, 204 pages) distilled into one skill entry: 59 capability cards covering dynamics fundamentals, dynamic material parameters, asphalt pavement response under moving loads, plate-on-elastic-foundation theory, FWD detection and modulus back-calculation, fatigue and fracture, and steel-bridge-deck paving. This is a judgement manual, not a calculator: every card states when NOT to use it, and the package refuses to produce a number the source cannot support. Four of the eight chapters promise more than they deliver (a structural-dynamics chapter mentioning pavement twice, a rigid-pavement chapter with zero mentions of joints or voids, a fatigue chapter with no life calculation at all), and that mismatch is documented as the package's own contribution together with roughly a hundred transcription defects. Ships with a 12-question blind-test log.
author: Qiujiyuantiantian
